interpretation: Numeric thresholds and three-entry perimeter approximation are authored implementation choices. Native scenario fidelity and competitive wins are distinct results.

situation.allies_concentrated(radius,min_count=4): Four living allies with at least ready_hp within group_radius of group center. Later cohort variants trim a distant fifth ally from that center.
situation.enemy_spread_out(dispersion_threshold): At least three currently observed living enemy heroes, bounding-box diagonal at least32 tiles. Unobserved enemies are unknown.
situation.near_base_perimeter(target_base): Group center within60tiles of public enemy-core coordinate; objective-stage logic additionally checks whether the next exposed structure belongs to the inner approach.

belief.team_assault_readiness: gaReady recomputed each decision from gaNear (BASIC alias defMates). Per-entry/probe/breach state persists in backdoor globals. Each hero has its own VM.
belief.home_pressure: V5 onward: positive observed alarm retains defUntil/defThreatX/Y for1200ticks through temporary fog. Memory is for navigation, not attacking an unseen target.

goal: G_group_siege links shared objective, group cohesion, gathered home defense and equipment funding; outcomes remain fort wins.
strategy: Ordered observe, attack, consumables, equipment and fallback rules refer to the group goal; the observer arbitrates readiness, home emergency, approach, probe and breach.

skill.GroupProbeAndCircleBase: Composite observer + formation combat + formation route; not a separate API. Re-scores three approach entries every240ticks; probe480ticks; breach commitment240ticks renewed by opportunity or timeout.
skill.fidelity_limit: Three exterior approach points approximate circling; no continuous orbit or guaranteed tower-aggro exclusion is claimed.

execution: Versioned contracts lower the selected operators into BASIC; mutually exclusive red/blue branches share aliased scratch storage within256globals. Final version coordinates128object observation and64object coached combat fast path.
update: Every saved pair records exact local/hosted outcomes and source evidence; contradicted competitive hypotheses are retained, not marked supported because a mechanism executes.
